race.comment: EARENDEL (4) put a couple of fair efforts in his only two starts last prep behind him when winning fresh up here very easily by over 2 lengths a fortnight ago over 1400m. He only carries an extra kilo for this, and has twice won over a mile in the past. Stick with him on top again. GO JEANIE (7) built strongly to a deserved win here over 1400m when third up from a spell. She carries 6kg less with the rise in class, and should go close to repeating the dose. COAL RIVER (5) is another very capable gelding who beat the second pick on his merits when leading all the way. He is nicely placed again, and should be the one to peg back. Go again. SH'BOURNE MIDNIGHT (6) can improve second up, and along with ZEWINNA (8), they can both fill a top 4 spot in the even field.
